history_scope: Recent feature additions from 2026-08-24 through 2026-10-28; backfill covers every currently registered smooth and canonical statistical family.

feature_commits.b33b23dd: Inverse Gaussian, quasi families, sc/scad, soap and structured compositions
feature_commits.6f048dd8: Joint Student location-scale, beta location-precision and negative-binomial location-dispersion

stages: Public predictions, components, uncertainty and persistence
invariants: Joint prediction covariance kernels, including cross-predictor blocks
Frequentist and smoothing-adjusted prediction covariance kernels where available
Supported response, Pearson and deviance residuals
comparison_policy: Never compare raw upstream basis columns, eigenvectors, coefficient arrays or coefficient-coordinate covariance matrices. Within one fitted object, stage ownership/transport checks use its own coordinate system.
scope_limits: Representative fixed smoothing cases are not a Cartesian product of all links, optimizers, dimensions and compositions; existing route/derivative/composition suites remain in place.
sc/scad without inequality requests match the corresponding mgcv bs/ad implementation; unsupported scasm constraints have separate explicit rejection tests.
Tweedie conditional comparison fixes scale=1 on both sides; default fixed-SP Pearson dispersion is not substituted for mgcv REML scale profiling.
Ordered categorical comparison fixes its cutpoint gap, preserving independent estimation tests in the ocat workflow suite.
SCAM native lipl standard-error prediction has a dimension error. Its R constructor and fitted covariance supply the identified prediction operator for this case.

student_lss, beta_lss and nb_lss have no equivalent smoothly varying two-parameter mgcv family. Independent SciPy penalized likelihood, information and criteria checks supplement existing R gamlss.dist density/MLE and torch fourth-order derivative tests.
Undefined quasi likelihood/AIC/BIC must stay undefined, not receive synthetic finite comparisons.
mgcv leaves Vc in fit coordinates when a setup transformation G$P is present. The source probe applies G$P before evaluating its unconditional prediction kernel.

Additional GAMLSS families are assigned to their dedicated extension suites and shared compiler/adapter contracts. These are GAMLSS probability/likelihood and independent numerical checks, not claims of equivalent mgcv families; unsupported derivative, fitting and smoothing routes remain explicitly tested.
